column1: # Manually-supplied T20 league champions not yet in the local cricsheet archive
# (cricsheet publishes ball-by-ball data a while after a final). build_t20_leagues.py

# so an entry here is harmless once cricsheet catches up.
# league_key is one of: ipl bbl psl cpl bpl blast smash hundred sa20 ilt20 lpl
